Data.subject: Transport
Data.title: Scheduled Aircraft And Transit Passengers, Monthly
Data.footnote: Refers to Changi Airport only.  Data covers scheduled passenger flight services from Changi Airport only.  Other aircraft service types like non-scheduled and scheduled cargo are excluded.  Local Airline refers to Singapore International Airlines (SQ), Silk Air (MI), Jetstar Asia (3K) and Scoot (TR).  Foreign Airline refers to the airlines that are not included in 'Local Airline'.
